name: Stiff Leg Deadlift
validation_note: Bands are the standard coaching ranges for this movement, not measured against a labelled clip. Treat a fix verdict as a prompt to look, not as a measured fault.

start_cue.en: Stand tall, then push your hips back with a flat back.
start_cue.hi: Seedhe khade ho, phir back flat rakhte hue hips peeche le jao.

good.en: Good. Your back stayed flat as you hinged.
good.hi: Badhiya. Hinge karte time back flat rahi.

fix.en: Your back is rounding. Keep your chest proud and push your hips back.
fix.hi: Back mud rahi hai. Chest aage rakho aur hips peeche le jao.

almost.en: Your back is rounding. Keep your chest proud and push your hips back.
almost.hi: Back mud rahi hai. Chest aage rakho aur hips peeche le jao.

good.en: Good. You pushed your hips back far enough.
good.hi: Badhiya. Aapne hips kaafi peeche kiye.

fix.en: Push your hips further back to feel the stretch.
fix.hi: Hips aur peeche le jao taaki stretch mehsoos ho.

below.en: Do not squat it. Keep a small bend in the knee.
below.hi: Squat mat karo. Knee mein halka bend rakho.

almost.en: Push your hips further back to feel the stretch.
almost.hi: Hips aur peeche le jao taaki stretch mehsoos ho.

good.en: Good. You stood all the way up.
good.hi: Badhiya. Aap poore khade ho gaye.

fix.en: Finish the rep standing tall with your glutes tight.
fix.hi: Rep poora karo, seedhe khade ho aur glutes tight karo.

almost.en: Finish the rep standing tall with your glutes tight.
almost.hi: Rep poora karo, seedhe khade ho aur glutes tight karo.

fix.en: Too fast. Control the way down and count 2.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Neeche control karo aur 2 gino.

below.en: Too fast. Control the way down and count 2.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Neeche control karo aur 2 gino.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds on the way down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.
